title: Viva Engage: collapse and resize the left navigation, and reorder a larger favourites list
summary: The briefing accurately reports the user-initiated navigation changes and the conflicting favourites limits in Microsoft's sources. The supplied notice supports the default state and lack of required admin action; targeted searches found no documented tenant-wide switch or navigation-specific licensing or meter.
